description: This file defines a singleton object `IconResolver` responsible for mapping icon names to drawable resource IDs within an Android project. It provides a method `resolveDrawableId` that uses provided asset mappings and fallback logic to determine the appropriate drawable resource.

classes.name: IconResolver
classes.description: A singleton object that resolves logical icon names to drawable resource IDs using asset mappings and fallback logic.

methods.name: resolveDrawableId
methods.description: Resolves a given icon name to its corresponding drawable resource ID, utilizing asset mappings and fallback defaults.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a default drawable resource ID when an icon name cannot be matched.
